This Eames chair can be had in good second hand condition for $3800. In five or ten years I can sell it for as much as I bought it for or more, adjusted for inflation. Once you get out of the consumer mindset you can thinking about asset depreciation curves and TCO. Don't buy disposable junk, buy asset class investments.
